item.title: Where Nelly Korda stands in LPGA Hall of Fame points
item.description: Here's where Korda stands in regards to the points-based LPGA Hall of Fame.

item.title: Nelly Korda declared winner after LPGA's decision to shorten opener amid extreme cold
item.description: With the LPGA canceling the final round of the Hilton Grand Vacations Tournament of Champions amid extreme cold, Korda’s 13 under was enough for a three-shot victory.

item.title: Farmers Insurance Open 2026 prize money: Full payout from $9.6 million purse
item.description: Here's how much of the $9.6-million purse at the 2026 Farmers Insurance Open will be paid out to Justin Rose.

item.title: In just three starts, Korn Ferry Tour's Ian Holt already a win away from promotion
item.description: Holt captured the Panama Championship to become the first KFT player to win two of the season’s first three tournaments.

item.title: Justin Rose: Fell into a good routine, great habits at Justin Rose: Fell into great routine, habits at Farmers
item.description: Justin Rose set the 72-hole course record at Torrey Pines this week. He spoke to Golf Channel's Todd Lewis after the final round Sunday and spoke about how he took advantage of favorable playing conditions during his wire-to-wire victory at the Farmers.

item.title: Korda wins 54-hole Tournament of Champions amid heavy winds
item.description: Nelly Korda won the LPGA's first tournament of the season but it came after a final-round cancelation at Lake Nona due to heavy winds. Golf Channel’s Amy Rogers spoke to several players, including Amy Yang, to get their reaction on the weather-related decision.

item.title: Is Justin Rose's career Hall of Fame worthy?
item.description: A 13-time winner on the PGA Tour after his wire-to-wire victory at Torrey Pines this week, Justin Rose is beginning to draw consideration for the World Golf Hall of Fame. The seven-time European Ryder Cup team member is projected to be ranked No. 3 in the world after the 2026 Farmers.

item.title: Koepka shoots 2-under 70 in final round at Torrey Pines
item.description: Brooks Koepka's first tournament back on the PGA Tour is in the books. The five-time major winner heads to Phoenix after finishing T-56 at Torrey Pines. Koepka shot 2-under 70 in the final round at the Farmers.

item.title: Looking back on 30 years of the TGR Foundation
item.description: TGR Foundation is celebrating its 30th anniversary this year. At an all-star gala in January, RED: Celebrating Legacy presented by EY, Tiger Woods and others spoke on the foundation's impact and how it will continue to change lives in the future.

item.title: PGA Tour Highlights 2026: Farmers Insurance Open, final round
item.description: Highlights from the final round of the PGA Tour's 2026 Farmers Insurance Open on the South Course at Torrey Pines, where a new scoring record was set.
